excerpt_i18n.en: On April 17, 2026, at the Zhangjiang Science Hall in Shanghai, the APC2026 Zhiyuan Partners Conference commenced promptly at 9:30 AM. The venue was filled with 2,500 partners from 34 countries and regions. The air was thick with a mix of anticipation and scrutiny—after three years of industry clamor, attendees were eager to hear concrete answers about "implementation." Zhiyuan's founder, chairman, and CEO, Deng Taihua, took the stage first. Without lengthy formalities, his speech resembled a seasoned leader's review of the past three years and a sober projection of the future. 01 Industry Narrative Shift: From "Development Phase" to "Deployment Phase" At the conference, Deng Taihua proposed an original viewpoint: the embodied intelligence sector follows an XYZ development curve. The X curve (2022–2025) represents the development and experimentation phase, where robots move like humans. During this stage, embodied intelligence was primarily applied to technology development in the scientific research and education markets, as well as in entertainment and commercial performance scenarios. Correspondingly, narratives from embodied intelligence companies revolved around the "development phase," competing through demos and funding, using dazzling stage performances to validate technical feasibility. In this phase, Zhiyuan launched its first robot, completed technical feasibility validation, and achieved mass production of over 5,000 units by 2025. The X curve drove rapid industry growth over the past three years, but due to the limited total space in the scientific research market, it has neared its ceiling, with marginal effects gradually slowing, necessitating a second growth phase.

El lugar estaba lleno con 2500 socios procedentes de 34 países y regiones. En el ambiente se respiraba una mezcla de expectación y escrutinio: tras tres años de bullicio en la industria, la gente ansiaba escuchar respuestas concretas sobre la "implementación". Deng Taihua, fundador, presidente y CEO de Inteligencia, fue el primero en subir al escenario. Sin largos preámbulos, su discurso se asemejó más a una revisión de los últimos tres años por parte de un líder en el campo, junto con una fría proyección del futuro. 01 Cambio de narrativa en la industria: de "estado de desarrollo" a "despliegue".

items.title: 从“供电”到“供算力”：光伏电站如何为数字中国注入“绿色动能”？
items.raw_excerpt: 随着“东数西算”工程深入推进及人工智能产业的爆发式增长,数字经济对能源供应提出了更高要求。2026 年,光伏电站作为绿色能源的重要组成部分,其角色正从单一的“发电单元”向“新基建关键基础设施”转变。资产安全性、供电稳定性与智能调度能力,成为衡量光伏项目价值的核心指标。 能源安全:数字基建的“生命线” 数据中心、智算中心等数字基础设施对电力中断“零容忍”。然而,极端气候频发与电力市场化改革,给能源供应带来了不确定性。 业内专家指出,光伏资产的安全防护能力,直接关系到区域电网的韧性与算力设施的连续运行。特别是在华南等台风频发区,组件的抗风压能力、冰雹防护等级,已成为项目选址与设备选型的关键考量因素。 在行业实践中,具备长期履约能力的品牌更受青睐。以天合光能为例,该企业成立于 1997 年,历经 29 年发展,多次获得彭博新能源财经(BNEF)100% 可融资性评级。 针对极端气候,天合光能推出了“抗台风 - 极御组件”,固定支架载荷能力达+8000Pa/-6000Pa,等效于17级超强台风的冲击；可有效减少资产损失风险;针对数字基建场景,其光储 +AI 解决方案实现了能源与算力的智能匹配。这种“产品安全 + 品牌履约 + 智能运营”的综合能力,正是光伏融入新基建体系的关键支撑。 在数字经济与能源转型双重浪潮下,光伏资产的安全性已超越单一能源范畴,成为保障算力安全、维护能源韧性的重要基石。未来,随着技术创新与场景深耕,光伏将在“新基建”版图中发挥更关键的作用。  雷峰网

With the deepening of the "East Data, West Computing" project and the explosive growth of the artificial intelligence industry, the digital economy is placing higher demands on energy supply. By 2026, photovoltaic power stations, as a crucial component of green energy, are transitioning from mere "power generation units" to "key infrastructure of new construction." Asset security, power supply stability, and intelligent dispatch capabilities have become core metrics for evaluating the value of photovoltaic projects.

Energy Security: The "Lifeline" of Digital Infrastructure  
Digital infrastructure such as data centers and intelligent computing centers have zero tolerance for power interruptions. However, frequent extreme weather events and electricity market reforms are introducing uncertainties to energy supply. Industry experts point out that the safety and protection capabilities of photovoltaic assets directly impact the resilience of regional power grids and the continuous operation of computing facilities. Particularly in typhoon-prone regions like South China, the wind resistance and hail protection ratings of components have become key considerations in project siting and equipment selection.

In industry practice, brands with long-term performance capabilities are more favored. For example, Trina Solar, founded in 1997 and with 29 years of development, has repeatedly received a 100% bankability rating from BloombergNEF (BNEF). To address extreme weather, Trina Solar has launched the "Typhoon-Resistant - Extreme Protection Module," with fixed bracket load capacities of +8000Pa/-6000Pa, equivalent to the impact of a Category 17 super typhoon, effectively reducing asset loss risks. For digital infrastructure scenarios, its solar-storage + AI solution enables intelligent matching of energy and computing power.

On April 20, Sunrise, a domestic full-stack self-developed AI inference GPU company, announced the completion of a new funding round exceeding 1 billion RMB. This marks one of the largest single financing rounds in the domestic GPU sector since the AI industry fully entered the era of "inference deployment and agent proliferation" in 2026. To date, having been spun off and operating independently for just over a year, Sunrise has completed a total of seven funding rounds, raising approximately 4 billion RMB, making it the first pure inference GPU unicorn in China with a valuation exceeding 10 billion RMB. The funds from this round will primarily be used for the large-scale mass production and delivery of the next-generation S3 inference GPU, the development of a full-stack software ecosystem, and the R&D iteration of subsequent S4/S5 chips.

The Year of the Agent, Inference Computing Power Becomes the Biggest Industry Bottleneck
2026 is widely recognized by the industry as the "Year of the AI Agent." As large models evolve from "chatting" to "thinking and executing" digital employees, inference demand has experienced explosive growth. The NVIDIA GTC 2026 conference officially declared that the AI industry has fully entered a new era of "inference deployment and agent proliferation," defining "tokens per watt throughput" as the core competitiveness of the AI era. This aligns closely with the core battlefield Sunrise has targeted since its inception.

"The focus of AI computing infrastructure has completely shifted," said Xu Bing, Chairman of Sunrise. "In 2026, the demand for AI inference computing is expected to reach 4-5 times that of training demand, with inference computing power rental prices rising nearly 40% in half a year." excerpt_i18n.es: El 20 de abril, la empresa china de GPU de inferencia AI de pila completa autodesarrollada Sunrise anunció la finalización de una nueva ronda de financiación de más de 1.000 millones de RMB. Esta es una de las mayores rondas de financiación individuales en el campo de GPU en China después de que la industria de AI entrara completamente en la era de "implementación de inferencia y popularización de agentes inteligentes" en 2026. Hasta ahora, Sunrise, que se escindió y se independizó hace poco más de un año, ha completado un total de siete rondas de financiación, con un monto total de aproximadamente 4.000 millones de RMB, convirtiéndose en el primer unicornio de GPU pura de inferencia en China con una valoración superior a los 10.000 millones de RMB. Los fondos de esta ronda se utilizarán principalmente para la producción y entrega a gran escala de la nueva generación de GPU de inferencia S3, la construcción del ecosistema de software de pila completa y el desarrollo iterativo de los chips posteriores S4/S5.

items.raw_excerpt: Eight years ago, my then-fiancée and I decided to get a prenup, so we hired a local mediator. The meetings were useful, but I felt there was no systematic process to produce a final agreement. So I started to think about this problem, and after a bit of research, I discovered the Nash bargaining solution. Yet if John Nash had solved negotiation in the 1950s, why did it seem like nobody was using it today?
